verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same leaderboard layout. The headline reads well. Two things are clearly broken: a dense legal block takes the right quarter at an unreadable ~5px, and the 'CLINICALLY TESTED' eyebrow has moved down to the bottom row after the logo, which breaks the reading order. The CTA, logo and jar are crammed into one small cluster on the bottom row, and the leaf strip on the left is a cropped scrap. B is very slightly better because its jar keeps more of its green lid, so it is easier to recognise. In A the jar shrinks to a pale smudge.
